metadata.title: A first high-quality vector data of buildings in East Asian countries based on a comprehensive large-scale mapping framework
metadata.description: We generate a high-quality and complete vector data of buildings in East Asian regions, including China, Japan, North Korea, South Korea and Mongolia, filling the gaps in the existing public buildings data.
